facts.fact: NewsDay reports Zimbabwe launched a nationwide Title Deeds Validation and Securitisation Programme under S.I. 76 of 2025 to verify and digitise existing title deeds, announced by the Permanent Secretary of Justice.
The Permanent Secretary said conveyancers submit the title deed information through the DLAP system to the Deeds Registry for processing, after which a securitised title deed is issued.
